requirements.requirement: The system must ingest clinical trial records containing phase, status, location, and eligibility attributes from clinical_trials_service.py outputs.
The system must apply the scoring schema defined in EVAL-CT-SCORE-SCHEMA-001 without deviation.
The system must compute normalized scores for each measure using the schema-defined normalization rules.
The system must apply deterministic weights to each normalized measure as defined in the schema.
The system must compute a composite score as a weighted aggregation of all available normalized measures.
The system must produce identical composite scores for identical input data across repeated executions.
The system must include individual measure scores and weights in the scoring output structure for each trial.
The system must ensure the final composite score is bounded within the schema-defined range (e.g., 0 to 1 or 0 to 100).
The system must calculate a proximity score using trial location and user or reference location when available.
The system must calculate a relevance score based on eligibility or condition matching when such data is present.
The system must handle missing measure data by applying schema-defined fallback or exclusion rules without failing the scoring process.
The system must assign a default score contribution of zero or schema-defined fallback when a required measure is completely absent.
The system must log scoring execution details including input measures and computed outputs for traceability.
The system must raise a controlled error or return a structured failure response when input data does not conform to the required schema.
